<b>Pale Rosary Necklaces</b> are [[Items (Silksong)#Consumables|consumable items]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
Pale Rosary Necklaces can be used from the inventory to gain {{R|340}}.

Strung Rosaries are not dropped upon death.

== How to Acquire ==
There are two Pale Rosary Necklaces that can be found by interacting with glowing spots across [[Pharloom]].
